chapterInfo.content:
10
Aboɔ apono no ho asɛm
1 # Eks 34.1; 25.10 Saa berɛ no na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Sene aboɔpono mmienu sɛ kane deɛ no na fa foro bra me nkyɛn bepɔ no so, na yɛ dua adaka; 2#Eks 32.19 na mɛtwerɛ nsɛm a ɛwɔ kane apono a wobobɔeɛ no soɔ no mahyɛ apono no so, na fa sie adaka no mu. 3Na meyɛɛ okuo adaka, na mesenee aboɔpono mmienu sɛ kane deɛ no, na meforoo bepɔ no a apono mmienu no kura me nsam. 4#Deut 9.10 Na AWURADE twerɛɛ apono no so sɛ kane ntwerɛeɛ no, nsɛm du no a ɔfiri ogya no mu ka kyerɛɛ mo wɔ bepɔ no so dwabɔ da no, na ɔde maa me. 5Na medanee me ho siane firii bepɔ no so, mede apono no mebɛsiee adaka a meyɛeɛ no mu, na ɛwɔ hɔ sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ me no.
6 # Num 33.32-33; 20.28 (Na Israelfoɔ tu firii Beerot-bene-yaakan kɔɔ Mosera. Ɛhɔ na Aaron wuiɛ na wɔsiee no wɔ hɔ, na ne ba Eleasa sii n’ananmu dii sɔfoɔ. 7Ɛfiri hɔ na wɔtu kɔɔ Gudgod, na wɔfirii Gudgod kɔɔ Yotbat, asase a nsutene wɔ soɔ. 8#Deut 18.5, 7; Num 6.23-27 Saa berɛ no na AWURADE yii Lewifoɔ abusuakuo sɛ wɔnsoa AWURADE apam adaka no, na wɔnnyina n’anim nsom no, na wɔmfa ne din nhyira, a wɔayɛ de abɛduru nnɛ da yi. 9Enti na Lewi annya kyɛfa ne agyapadeɛ ne nuanom mu. AWURADE ne n’agyapadeɛ, sɛdeɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ no no.)
10 # Deut 9.9 Na me deɛ, megyinaa bepɔ no so sɛ kane no, adaduanan awia ne anadwo, na AWURADE tiee me saa berɛ no nso, na wampɛ sɛ ɔsɛe woɔ. 11Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Sɔre kɔdi ɔman no anim ma wɔntu nkɔfa asase a mekaa wɔn nananom ntam sɛ mede bɛma wɔn no.
AWURADE apɛdeɛ
12 # Mika 6.8 Na afei, Israel, ɛdeɛn na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn repɛ no wo nkyɛn? Ɛne sɛ wobɛsuro AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, na wonante n’akwan nyinaa soɔ, na woadɔ no, na wode w’akoma nyinaa ne wo kra nyinaa asom AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, 13na woadi ne mmara nsɛm ne n’ahyɛdeɛ a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi soɔ, na asi wo yie. 14Hwɛ, ɔsoro ne ɔsoro mu soro yɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn dea, asase ne deɛ ɛwɔ mu nyinaa. 15#Deut 7.6 Nanso wo nananom nko na AWURADE bata wɔn ho sɛ ɔbɛdɔ wɔn, na wayi wɔn asefoɔ a wɔdi wɔn akyire a ɛne mo, afiri aman nyinaa mu, sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ nnɛ yi. 16#Deut 30.6 Enti montwitwa mo akoma twetia, na monnsene mo kɔn bio. 17Na AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn yɛ anyame mu Nyankopɔn, ne Awurade mu Awurade, Onyankopɔn kɛseɛ no, Otumfoɔ a ne ho yɛ hu a ɔnhwɛ nnipa anim na ɔnnye adanmudeɛ; 18ɔbu atɛn ma awisiaa ne okunafoɔ, na ɔdɔ ɔhɔhoɔ ma no aduane ne nkataho. 19#Eks 22.21-24 Enti monnɔ ahɔhoɔ, ɛfiri sɛ moyɛɛ ahɔhoɔ Misraim asase so. 20AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn na suro no, ɔno na som no, na ne ho na bata, na ne din ho ntam na ka. 21Ɔno ne w’ayeyie, na ɔne wo Nyankopɔn a wayɛ nnoɔma akɛseɛ a ɛyɛ hu a w’ani ahunu yi ama woɔ. 22#Gye 46.27; Deut 1.10 Akra aduɔson na wo nananom de siane kɔɔ Misraim, afei AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ayɛ wo dodoɔ sɛ ɔsoro nsoromma.

pageProps.chapterText:
Saa berɛ no na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Sene aboɔpono mmienu sɛ kane deɛ no na fa foro bra me nkyɛn bepɔ no so, na yɛ dua adaka; na mɛtwerɛ nsɛm a ɛwɔ kane apono a wobobɔeɛ no soɔ no mahyɛ apono no so, na fa sie adaka no mu. Na meyɛɛ okuo adaka, na mesenee aboɔpono mmienu sɛ kane deɛ no, na meforoo bepɔ no a apono mmienu no kura me nsam. Na AWURADE twerɛɛ apono no so sɛ kane ntwerɛeɛ no, nsɛm du no a ɔfiri ogya no mu ka kyerɛɛ mo wɔ bepɔ no so dwabɔ da no, na ɔde maa me. Na medanee me ho siane firii bepɔ no so, mede apono no mebɛsiee adaka a meyɛeɛ no mu, na ɛwɔ hɔ sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ me no.
(Na Israelfoɔ tu firii Beerot-bene-yaakan kɔɔ Mosera. Ɛhɔ na Aaron wuiɛ na wɔsiee no wɔ hɔ, na ne ba Eleasa sii n’ananmu dii sɔfoɔ. Ɛfiri hɔ na wɔtu kɔɔ Gudgod, na wɔfirii Gudgod kɔɔ Yotbat, asase a nsutene wɔ soɔ. Saa berɛ no na AWURADE yii Lewifoɔ abusuakuo sɛ wɔnsoa AWURADE apam adaka no, na wɔnnyina n’anim nsom no, na wɔmfa ne din nhyira, a wɔayɛ de abɛduru nnɛ da yi. Enti na Lewi annya kyɛfa ne agyapadeɛ ne nuanom mu. AWURADE ne n’agyapadeɛ, sɛdeɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ka kyerɛɛ no no.)
Na me deɛ, megyinaa bepɔ no so sɛ kane no, adaduanan awia ne anadwo, na AWURADE tiee me saa berɛ no nso, na wampɛ sɛ ɔsɛe woɔ. Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Sɔre kɔdi ɔman no anim ma wɔntu nkɔfa asase a mekaa wɔn nananom ntam sɛ mede bɛma wɔn no.

Na afei, Israel, ɛdeɛn na AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn repɛ no wo nkyɛn? Ɛne sɛ wobɛsuro AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, na wonante n’akwan nyinaa soɔ, na woadɔ no, na wode w’akoma nyinaa ne wo kra nyinaa asom AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn, na woadi ne mmara nsɛm ne n’ahyɛdeɛ a merehyɛ wo nnɛ yi soɔ, na asi wo yie. Hwɛ, ɔsoro ne ɔsoro mu soro yɛ AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn dea, asase ne deɛ ɛwɔ mu nyinaa. Nanso wo nananom nko na AWURADE bata wɔn ho sɛ ɔbɛdɔ wɔn, na wayi wɔn asefoɔ a wɔdi wɔn akyire a ɛne mo, afiri aman nyinaa mu, sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ nnɛ yi. Enti montwitwa mo akoma twetia, na monnsene mo kɔn bio. Na AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn yɛ anyame mu Nyankopɔn, ne Awurade mu Awurade, Onyankopɔn kɛseɛ no, Otumfoɔ a ne ho yɛ hu a ɔnhwɛ nnipa anim na ɔnnye adanmudeɛ; ɔbu atɛn ma awisiaa ne okunafoɔ, na ɔdɔ ɔhɔhoɔ ma no aduane ne nkataho. Enti monnɔ ahɔhoɔ, ɛfiri sɛ moyɛɛ ahɔhoɔ Misraim asase so. AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn na suro no, ɔno na som no, na ne ho na bata, na ne din ho ntam na ka. Ɔno ne w’ayeyie, na ɔne wo Nyankopɔn a wayɛ nnoɔma akɛseɛ a ɛyɛ hu a w’ani ahunu yi ama woɔ. Akra aduɔson na wo nananom de siane kɔɔ Misraim, afei AWURADE wo Nyankopɔn ayɛ wo dodoɔ sɛ ɔsoro nsoromma.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
